title: A low-rank decoder bottleneck bounds reliability in foundation-model perturbation prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.05849v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Foundation-model predictors of perturbation response are evaluated primarily by aggregate accuracy. Using their predictions to prioritize experiments requires assessing each prediction's reliability. We audit the state-transition (ST) decoder used in STATE across three encoders (SE-600M, scGPT, and Tahoe-x1) and four cell lines under CRISPRi. The decoder's first attention layer has a low-rank output. Projecting this output onto 4-32 fixed directions estimated from training activations preserves mean per-perturbation Pearson delta correlation (PDC). This low-rank attention bottleneck bounds the decoder's reliability by distance to training responses: PDC declines as the cosine distance from a perturbation's observed response to its nearest training response increases. translated_title: 低秩解码器瓶颈限制了基础模型扰动预测的可靠性
translated_abstract: 基础模型的扰动响应预测器通常主要以总体准确率来评估。若要利用其预测结果来优先安排实验，就需要评估每一条预测的可靠性。我们对STATE中使用的状态转移（ST）解码器进行了审计，涵盖三个编码器（SE-600M、scGPT和Tahoe-x1）以及CRISPRi条件下的四种细胞系。该解码器的第一个注意力层具有低秩输出。将该输出投影到从训练激活中估计的4-32个固定方向上，即可保持每个扰动的平均皮尔逊delta相关性（PDC）。这一低秩注意力瓶颈使解码器的可靠性受到其与训练响应之间距离的约束：随着扰动的观测响应与其最近训练响应之间的余弦距离增大，PDC随之下降。我们提出“预测最近邻距离”——即预测响应到其最近训练响应的余弦距离——作为每条预测的置信度评分。
tldr: 该论文发现基础模型扰动预测中状态转移解码器的第一注意力层存在低秩瓶颈，其预测可靠性由预测响应与训练响应的距离所限定，并提出以“预测最近邻距离”作为逐条预测的置信度评分。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a low-rank bottleneck in the first attention layer of the state-transition decoder in foundation-model perturbation prediction, shows that per-prediction reliability is bounded by the distance to training responses, and proposes predicted-NN-distance as a per-prediction confidence score.
